summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing (1920px and 390px) of Phase 1 admin data screens (Endpoint explorer, Cache and usage, Leagues) and the Site Studio header logo (logo_dark/logo_light upload, publish, theme switch, broken-image fallback, restore). Owner first sign-in done once (2FA enrolment, recovery codes, password change), then I reused the session cookie in later scripts, so no rate limits were hit. Every requested flow passed. No page errors or crashes. I found no blocking bugs. A few minor UX and design notes are below. No code was changed.

minor.issue: Return 404 HTTP_404 as expected, because the user refused the backend change. The UI handles this with the routes-missing card.

issues: In the 3-column form row the Season field has a hint below it, so its label sits higher than the 'League id' and 'Status' labels. Use align-items:start or put the hint under the row.
After Run, the routes-missing card (or a result) shows below the fold under the long form, so nothing visibly changes on screen. Scroll the card or result into view after Run.
MissingRoutes renders an <h1> inside a page that already has an <h1> from PageHead, which gives 2 h1s. Use h2.
Leagues PageHead has no lead line, while Cache and Explorer have one. This is inconsistent.
The mini preview (Phone/Desktop, Dark/Light) does not show the uploaded logo. The header in the preview shows only 'Forecast', so the owner cannot check the logo before publishing.
Field order puts 'Logo light' before 'Logo dark' in the grid, and the row heights do not match (Name/Tagline inputs are taller than the image inputs).
The footer brand still uses the plain .brand-mark (Layout.jsx line 103) and not BrandLogo, so the uploaded logo shows only in the header.
The logo is shown next to the brand-name text. If the logo is a wordmark, the name appears twice. Consider hiding .brand-name when a logo is set, or add a setting for it.

passed: Owner first sign-in with ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD: /enroll-2fa, manual secret, TOTP accepted, 10 recovery codes, 'I saved them' then Continue, /change-password to Owner-Test-Pass-2026!x, lands on /admin

Explorer: explorer-call is a real <select>. The default 'All leagues' path is 'GET /v1/leagues' and Run is enabled. 'A league's matches' shows League id, Season (default 2025/2026) and Status (default all). Run is disabled until a league id is typed, and stays disabled for whitespace only. The path URL-encodes values ('eng 1/x' becomes eng%201%2Fx, season 2024%2F2025, status=played). The Date and Player calls change the fields and the path. Typed values are kept when switching calls
Explorer Run shows routes-missing 'Waiting for the server routes', no explorer-result, no crash, no FormError
Force refresh opens explorer-force-confirm ('Make a real call?' / 'Call PitchAPI'). Cancel closes it. OK runs and shows routes-missing. Changing the call clears the card
Cache and usage (/admin/data/cache) shows the routes-missing card

390px: More sheet tiles admin-more-tile-explorer/cache/leagues open each page, the sheet closes, overflow is 0px on all 3 (also with the matches form filled). The force-confirm sheet looks right on phone

Studio Brand tab: f-logo_dark-upload and f-logo_light-upload use a hidden file input. Uploading 2 PNGs (red 64x28 and blue 64x28) fills /api/site/assets/<id>, shows the toast 'Image uploaded. Save to draft to keep it.' and the thumbs load (naturalWidth 64). Save to draft worked, then Publish with note gave 'Published version 1'
Public header (signed out): img[data-testid=brand-logo] uses the light asset in light theme and the dark asset after theme-toggle, and back again. 390px header shows the logo with no overflow
Broken logo (asset requests routed to 404): the header falls back to .brand-mark in both themes, with no broken-image icon
Remove (f-logo_*-clear) empties the field and hides the Remove button. Restored with an empty logo pair and published as version 2. The public header has no brand-logo and shows the brand-mark again

Optional: scroll the result or routes-missing card into view after Run on mobile. Fix the Season hint misalignment. Use h2 in MissingRoutes

critical_code_review_comments: parts.jsx notMounted matches any HTTP_404. This is fine for now. When the routes land, a real 404 such as GET /admin/cache/{id} for a deleted row would still show 'waiting for routes' only where notMounted is used (Explorer/Cache top level). Remove these guards once the backend is mounted
Cache.jsx: when /admin/usage is 404, CacheTable is not rendered at all. This is OK because both routes come together, but the coupling is implicit
BrandLogo: if the mode's logo fails, it falls back to the brand mark and not to the other mode's logo. This is acceptable
Explorer save(): the filename comes from res.path with '/' replaced, but the query params are not in the name, so different seasons give the same fixture filename

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed. Only minor design notes

The Studio route is /admin/studio (not /admin/site/studio). Phase 1 data routes are on /admin/data/{explorer,cache,leagues}. The file input is '[data-testid=f-logo_dark-upload] input[type=file]'.
